scripts.dev:
concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,INFO" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "sleep 6 && echo '
✅ All servers running:
   🌐 Frontend: http://localhost:5173
   🚀 Backend:  http://localhost:3000
'"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install-all && cp backend/.env.example backend/.env && npx --prefix backend prisma db push
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
